title: The Space page and member profile flash a DAWN loading skeleton before the Frequency page

source.ref: Site scan 2026-10-14 (scan nine, thread 'Site scan'), against origin/main eb26a01 and production.

detail: FILED 2026-10-14. THE CONSEQUENCE: app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/loading.tsx draws DAWN's cover-and-avatar skeleton, but the Frequency Space page is space-chrome ((profile)/layout.tsx:711); same for app/(main)/people/[handle]/loading.tsx against page.tsx:530. Visitors see the old layout, then a jump. Practices, crew, nearby, network, store and journeys loading/error files are also unported. Precedent: components/frequency/members/event/event-loading.tsx. THE FIX: branch both loading files on SITE_DESIGN.
